description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for a `ChannelsSettings` view, defining its UI layout, including sidebar and detail views for managing channels, as well as associated UI components like headers, rows, and badges.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main layout of the `ChannelsSettings` view using SwiftUI components, handling appearance and state changes.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Creates a scrollable sidebar list of channels, separated into 'Configured' and 'Available' sections.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays detailed information for the selected channel or a placeholder message when none is selected.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view prompting users to select a channel.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Constructs the detailed view for a specific channel, including header and section content.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Renders an individual row in the sidebar list for a channel, including selection highlighting.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Creates a header label for sections within the sidebar.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Builds the header section for channel details, including title, status badge, last check time, and error indication.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Displays a colored badge indicating the status of a channel.
